definition.def: Something that is an integral part of something is an essential part of that thing.
examples: Rituals and festivals form an integral part of every human society.
Anxiety is integral to the human condition.

examples.sentence: Dung beetles have become an integral part of the successful management of dairy farms in Australia over the past few decades.
So integral have these time-based technologies become to day-to-day existence that our dependency on them is recognised only when they fail to work.
"The Happiness Industry" describes how the project of a science of happiness has become integral to capitalism.
The sports psychologist works closely with the athlete through his or her training program, and becomes an integral part of the team.
Unfortunately, not all colleges and universities have CAD as an integral part of their courses.
The architect Richard Rogers proposed an integral turbine for the Tomigaya Tower in Tokyo in 1993, but his plan was turned down.
